pool: Retain all baseline files/records inside a max100 file pool, then fill by best existing passage cosine. Within each file retain baseline records and fill to16 by cosine; first4 are file representatives.
file_selection: Max library cross-encoder score over the four representatives per file. Tie: original file-pool rank. No aliases, role guesses, expected-answer input or weight sweep.
member_selection: Score remaining admitted members in the best5 files, reuse already computed scores, return3 per file as separate navigation. Do not assert native Pack completion or change the historical navigation cap2.
exact: Native owner/identifier-confirmed routes preserve the original result and do not rerank.
acceptance: Preserve all64 protected first5/top20 hits, improve at least one old miss, find all four existing new-case targets in first5, improve source-hash-bound writer clause-range coverage without treating path hits as complete answers. No activation on failure.
